tickets.title: Provision dbt Cloud seat for new analytics engineer
tickets.description: Our new analytics engineer starts on the 28th and needs a developer seat plus access to the `client_telco` project.

tickets.title: Employment confirmation letter for visa application
tickets.description: I need a letter confirming my role, start date and salary for a Schengen visa application. Appointment is on the 2nd.

comments.body: Draft is ready and waiting for signature from the Head of People. You’ll have it by Friday.

tickets.title: Expense claim for Kisumu client visit not reimbursed
tickets.description: I submitted a claim for KES 18,400 (fuel, accommodation, meals) on the 2nd and it still shows as pending.

comments.body: Two receipts were missing from the claim. Could you upload the hotel invoice and the fuel receipt?
Uploaded both just now.

tickets.title: Scan-to-email not working on the 2nd floor printer
tickets.description: The Kyocera on the 2nd floor shows "SMTP authentication failed" when scanning to email. Printing works fine.

tickets.title: Airflow nightly ingest DAG running out of memory
tickets.description: The `retail_bank_daily_ingest` DAG has been killed with OOM on the transform step for the last three nights. Row counts roughly doubled after the new branch data feed went live.

comments.body: Switching the transform to process partitions in chunks of 500k rows instead of loading the whole day into memory.

tickets.title: Cracked laptop screen needs replacing
tickets.description: My laptop screen cracked in transit. It still works but there’s a line across the bottom third. Asset tag ANN-LT-471.

comments.body: Replacement screen arrived from the supplier. Can you drop the laptop at the IT desk on Thursday morning? Loaner is ready.
Dropped it off, thanks for the loaner.
Screen replaced — please check it over before I close this.

tickets.title: CI pipeline failing on main — flaky integration tests
tickets.description: The `integration-postgres` job has failed 4 of the last 6 runs on main. Failures are timeouts in the ledger reconciliation suite, not assertion errors. This is blocking the Friday release.

comments.body: Looks like the test container is starved — the runner pool was downsized last week. Bumping the job to the large runner as a first step.
FYI the same suite passes locally in ~90s, so it is almost certainly resource contention.

tickets.title: Rotate AWS access keys for the analytics service account
tickets.description: Quarterly key rotation is due for `svc-analytics`. Keys are referenced in the Airflow connections and two Lambda functions.

comments.body: New keys are in Secrets Manager and Airflow connections are updated. PR for the Lambda env vars is up for review.
Reviewed — one nit on the IAM policy, otherwise good to merge.

tickets.title: Clarify probation review date
tickets.description: My offer letter says a 3-month probation, but the system shows my review a month later. Which date is correct?

tickets.title: Per diem advance for regional workshop
tickets.description: Requesting a per diem advance for 4 nights for the regional partner workshop. Travel is approved by my manager.

tickets.title: Onboarding: GitHub + Slack access for new starter
tickets.description: Please set up accounts for Nafula Njoroge, who joins this week: Google Workspace, Slack (#general, #team-channel), GitHub org membership and 1Password.

comments.body: Google account created. Slack and GitHub invites go out once the laptop is enrolled in MDM.

tickets.title: Book boardroom and catering for the quarterly all-hands
tickets.description: Quarterly all-hands on the 30th, 2pm–5pm. We expect about 40 people in person — please arrange tea, snacks and the screen.

comments.body: Boardroom booked and catering quote received (KES 24,000). Can you confirm headcount by Friday?

tickets.title: Refresh staging database from anonymised production snapshot
tickets.description: Staging data is three months old and QA cannot reproduce the M-Pesa callback issues reported by the client. Please restore last Sunday’s anonymised snapshot.

tickets.title: Broken chair in meeting room 2
tickets.description: One of the chairs in meeting room 2 has a broken gas lift and sinks to the floor. It’s been moved to the corner and taped.

tickets.title: Deprecate legacy /v1/reports endpoint
tickets.description: Only one client still calls `/v1/reports`. Agree a sunset date with Delivery and add a deprecation header in the meantime.

tickets.title: Second monitor for home office
tickets.description: Requesting a 24" monitor for my home setup under the hybrid work policy. Approved by my manager.

tickets.title: Wi-Fi keeps dropping in the boardroom
tickets.description: Video calls in the boardroom drop every 10–15 minutes. Other rooms seem fine. Happened during two client calls this week.

comments.body: The boardroom access point is on an old firmware and roaming aggressively. Scheduled an update for 7pm tonight.
Let’s also move the AP off channel 6 — it overlaps with the neighbouring office.

tickets.title: Air conditioning not working on the 3rd floor
tickets.description: The AC on the 3rd floor has been off since Monday. It’s above 29°C in the afternoons.

comments.body: Technician is booked for Thursday 9am. Portable fans are in the store room in the meantime.
Thanks — the fans help a lot.

tickets.title: Laptop not connecting to VPN
tickets.description: Since yesterday’s macOS update GlobalProtect hangs at "Connecting…" and then times out. I’m working remotely today and can’t reach the file server or the ERP.

comments.body: Can you remove the VPN profile and reinstall it from Self Service? The update reset the system extension approval.
Reinstalled — still stuck on Connecting…
I’ve pushed a new configuration profile to your device. Please restart and try again.

tickets.title: Payslip shows wrong SHIF deduction
tickets.description: My August payslip deducts SHIF of KES 4,950, but at 2.75% of my gross it should be closer to KES 3,850. Could you check whether an arrear was applied?

comments.body: Thanks for flagging. It looks like a one-off July arrear was added to August. I’m confirming with Finance.
Confirmed: KES 1,100 was a July top-up. A breakdown note will be added to your payslip and September will be correct.
That makes sense, thanks for explaining.

tickets.title: Add newborn as a dependant on medical cover
tickets.description: Our daughter was born on the 14th. Please add her to my medical cover — the birth notification is attached.

comments.body: Congratulations! Forms submitted to the insurer; cover is backdated to the date of birth.

tickets.title: Corporate card limit increase for cloud billing
tickets.description: Our monthly cloud bill is now above the KES 500,000 card limit and the last charge was declined.

comments.body: The bank has approved a temporary increase to KES 800,000. Waiting on CEO sign-off to make it permanent.

tickets.title: Leave balance not showing carried-over days
tickets.description: I carried over 5 annual leave days from last year, but my balance only shows the 2026 accrual.

tickets.title: Update bank details for salary payments
tickets.description: I’ve moved my salary account from Equity to NCBA. The bank letter is attached in my documents.

comments.body: Updated and verified with Finance. The change applies from the September payroll.

tickets.title: Access to the finance@ shared mailbox
tickets.description: I’m covering supplier queries while a colleague is on leave and need delegate access to finance@ for two weeks.

comments.body: Delegate access granted until the 9th. It should appear in Outlook within 30 minutes.

tickets.title: Confirm 2026 mileage reimbursement rate
tickets.description: Is the mileage rate still KES 35/km after the fuel price review, or has it changed?

tickets.title: P9 form for 2025 tax returns
tickets.description: I didn’t receive my P9 form and need it to file on iTax before the deadline.

comments.body: Your P9 has been uploaded to Documents → Payslips.

tickets.title: Access to Grafana dashboards
tickets.description: I need read access to the Production Grafana folder (Payments API latency and Kafka consumer lag) before my on-call rotation starts on Monday.

comments.body: Added you to the grafana-viewers group. Can you confirm you can see the "Payments API" folder?
Confirmed — I can see both dashboards now. Thanks!

tickets.title: MFA reset — lost phone
tickets.description: I lost my phone over the weekend and can’t sign in to email or the HR system. I have a new SIM with the same number.

comments.body: Identity verified by phone. MFA has been reset — you’ll be prompted to enrol your new device at next sign-in.
All working again. Thank you for the quick turnaround.

tickets.title: Add Google Workspace SSO to the internal admin tool
tickets.description: The internal admin tool still uses local passwords. We should move it behind Google Workspace SSO before the ISO 27001 audit in November.

tickets.title: Microsoft 365 licence for incoming contractor
tickets.description: We have a contractor joining for a three-month engagement who needs an E3 licence and access to the project SharePoint.

comments.body: Cancelling — the contractor will use their own firm’s tenant with guest access instead.

tickets.title: Reserved parking slot request
tickets.description: Requesting a reserved parking slot on the days I come in with equipment for client demos.

comments.body: We don’t have reserved slots available this quarter — the loading bay can be used for drop-offs.

tickets.title: Water dispenser in the kitchen needs servicing
tickets.description: The water dispenser is leaking and the filter light has been red for a week.

tickets.title: Access card not opening the side entrance
tickets.description: My access card works at the main door but not the side entrance near the parking lot.

comments.body: Your card was missing from the side-door access group. Added — please test it tomorrow morning.

tickets.title: Supplier invoice stuck in approval
tickets.description: Invoice INV-2026-0918 from our cleaning services supplier has been pending approval for three weeks and they’ve sent a reminder.

comments.body: The approver was on leave. Re-routed to the deputy and the invoice is approved.
Payment released in today’s run.

tickets.title: Leave balance not showing carried-over days
tickets.description: I carried over 5 annual leave days from last year, but my balance only shows the 2026 accrual.

tickets.title: Book boardroom and catering for the quarterly all-hands
tickets.description: Quarterly all-hands on the 30th, 2pm–5pm. We expect about 40 people in person — please arrange tea, snacks and the screen.

comments.body: Boardroom booked and catering quote received (KES 24,000). Can you confirm headcount by Friday?

tickets.title: Add newborn as a dependant on medical cover
tickets.description: Our daughter was born on the 14th. Please add her to my medical cover — the birth notification is attached.

comments.body: Congratulations! Forms submitted to the insurer; cover is backdated to the date of birth.

tickets.title: Wi-Fi keeps dropping in the boardroom
tickets.description: Video calls in the boardroom drop every 10–15 minutes. Other rooms seem fine. Happened during two client calls this week.

comments.body: The boardroom access point is on an old firmware and roaming aggressively. Scheduled an update for 7pm tonight.
Let’s also move the AP off channel 6 — it overlaps with the neighbouring office.

tickets.title: Website contact form sending enquiries to an old inbox
tickets.description: Enquiries from the website contact form are going to an address that was retired in July. We may have missed customer requests.

comments.body: Found it — the form still posts to the old SMTP relay. Updating the recipient and adding a copy to the shared inbox.

tickets.title: Laptop not connecting to VPN
tickets.description: Since yesterday’s macOS update GlobalProtect hangs at "Connecting…" and then times out. I’m working remotely today and can’t reach the file server or the ERP.

comments.body: Can you remove the VPN profile and reinstall it from Self Service? The update reset the system extension approval.
Reinstalled — still stuck on Connecting…
I’ve pushed a new configuration profile to your device. Please restart and try again.

tickets.title: Employment confirmation letter for visa application
tickets.description: I need a letter confirming my role, start date and salary for a Schengen visa application. Appointment is on the 2nd.

comments.body: Draft is ready and waiting for signature from the Head of People. You’ll have it by Friday.

tickets.title: Onboarding: GitHub + Slack access for new starter
tickets.description: Please set up accounts for Ngozi Otieno, who joins this week: Google Workspace, Slack (#general, #team-channel), GitHub org membership and 1Password.

comments.body: Google account created. Slack and GitHub invites go out once the laptop is enrolled in MDM.

tickets.title: Cracked laptop screen needs replacing
tickets.description: My laptop screen cracked in transit. It still works but there’s a line across the bottom third. Asset tag CHQ-LT-449.

comments.body: Replacement screen arrived from the supplier. Can you drop the laptop at the IT desk on Thursday morning? Loaner is ready.
Dropped it off, thanks for the loaner.
Screen replaced — please check it over before I close this.

tickets.title: Access to the finance@ shared mailbox
tickets.description: I’m covering supplier queries while a colleague is on leave and need delegate access to finance@ for two weeks.

comments.body: Delegate access granted until the 9th. It should appear in Outlook within 30 minutes.

tickets.title: Broken chair in meeting room 2
tickets.description: One of the chairs in meeting room 2 has a broken gas lift and sinks to the floor. It’s been moved to the corner and taped.

tickets.title: Corporate card limit increase for cloud billing
tickets.description: Our monthly cloud bill is now above the KES 500,000 card limit and the last charge was declined.

comments.body: The bank has approved a temporary increase to KES 800,000. Waiting on CEO sign-off to make it permanent.

tickets.title: Expense claim for Kisumu client visit not reimbursed
tickets.description: I submitted a claim for KES 18,400 (fuel, accommodation, meals) on the 2nd and it still shows as pending.

comments.body: Two receipts were missing from the claim. Could you upload the hotel invoice and the fuel receipt?
Uploaded both just now.

tickets.title: Per diem advance for regional workshop
tickets.description: Requesting a per diem advance for 4 nights for the regional partner workshop. Travel is approved by my manager.

tickets.title: Air conditioning not working on the 3rd floor
tickets.description: The AC on the 3rd floor has been off since Monday. It’s above 29°C in the afternoons.

comments.body: Technician is booked for Thursday 9am. Portable fans are in the store room in the meantime.
Thanks — the fans help a lot.

tickets.title: Payslip shows wrong SHIF deduction
tickets.description: My August payslip deducts SHIF of KES 4,950, but at 2.75% of my gross it should be closer to KES 3,850. Could you check whether an arrear was applied?

comments.body: Thanks for flagging. It looks like a one-off July arrear was added to August. I’m confirming with Finance.
Confirmed: KES 1,100 was a July top-up. A breakdown note will be added to your payslip and September will be correct.
That makes sense, thanks for explaining.

tickets.title: Second monitor for home office
tickets.description: Requesting a 24" monitor for my home setup under the hybrid work policy. Approved by my manager.

tickets.title: Reserved parking slot request
tickets.description: Requesting a reserved parking slot on the days I come in with equipment for client demos.

comments.body: We don’t have reserved slots available this quarter — the loading bay can be used for drop-offs.

tickets.title: Replace the paper incident log with a simple digital form
tickets.description: Supervisors still fill in incidents on paper and scan them weekly. A shared digital form with photo upload would save hours and make trends visible.

tickets.title: Scan-to-email not working on the 2nd floor printer
tickets.description: The Kyocera on the 2nd floor shows "SMTP authentication failed" when scanning to email. Printing works fine.

tickets.title: Access card not opening the side entrance
tickets.description: My access card works at the main door but not the side entrance near the parking lot.

comments.body: Your card was missing from the side-door access group. Added — please test it tomorrow morning.

tickets.title: Confirm 2026 mileage reimbursement rate
tickets.description: Is the mileage rate still KES 35/km after the fuel price review, or has it changed?

tickets.title: Water dispenser in the kitchen needs servicing
tickets.description: The water dispenser is leaking and the filter light has been red for a week.

tickets.title: P9 form for 2025 tax returns
tickets.description: I didn’t receive my P9 form and need it to file on iTax before the deadline.

comments.body: Your P9 has been uploaded to Documents → Payslips.

tickets.title: MFA reset — lost phone
tickets.description: I lost my phone over the weekend and can’t sign in to email or the HR system. I have a new SIM with the same number.

comments.body: Identity verified by phone. MFA has been reset — you’ll be prompted to enrol your new device at next sign-in.
All working again. Thank you for the quick turnaround.

tickets.title: Update bank details for salary payments
tickets.description: I’ve moved my salary account from Equity to NCBA. The bank letter is attached in my documents.

comments.body: Updated and verified with Finance. The change applies from the September payroll.

tickets.title: Clarify probation review date
tickets.description: My offer letter says a 3-month probation, but the system shows my review a month later. Which date is correct?

tickets.title: Supplier invoice stuck in approval
tickets.description: Invoice INV-2026-0918 from our cleaning services supplier has been pending approval for three weeks and they’ve sent a reminder.

comments.body: The approver was on leave. Re-routed to the deputy and the invoice is approved.
Payment released in today’s run.

tickets.title: Microsoft 365 licence for incoming contractor
tickets.description: We have a contractor joining for a three-month engagement who needs an E3 licence and access to the project SharePoint.

comments.body: Cancelling — the contractor will use their own firm’s tenant with guest access instead.
